description: Price and rent ranges from registered DLD deals and Ejari contracts, with sample sizes, 12-month forecast interval and our public backtest. Abstains when the sample is too small.

area.description: Area name or slug: any of the Dubai areas from list_areas, e.g. "Dubai Marina", "jumeirah-village-circle", "JVC" or "Jumeirah Park".

building.description: Building name as registered with DLD (apartments), e.g. "Marina Gate 1". Optional: that building (with comparables when segment is also given).

segment.description: Segment key from get_area_snapshot, e.g. "apartment-1br" or "villa-4br". Optional: all segments if omitted.

name: get_area_snapshot
title: Area price and rent snapshot
